description_summary: Scope or freeze which files Claude can edit during debugging, a refactor, or review. Use when edits should stay in specific dirs, or for a read-only investigate lock. Backed by a sentinel + PreToolUse hook.
should_trigger: Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
Make this session read only using the existing edit freeze.
Allow editing only apps/mobile and keep other directories frozen.
Turn off the explicit editing freeze for the authorized task.
Inspect the current allowed edit directories.
should_trigger_test: Explain which editing tools the freeze covers and why Bash is different.
Narrow the edit scope without allowing paths that escape through symlinks.
should_not_trigger: Fix this typo in one mobile component with a contained edit.
Execute the tasks in this existing implementation plan.
Review this branch diff for correctness and starter architecture issues.
Audit the pnpm lock dependency graph for supply-chain risks.
